subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who eats human flesh.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cannibal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Cannibal"** means one who eats human flesh. (आदमखोर)
 
 
• **Example:** In certain mythologies, a cannibal is a person who practices cannibalism.
 
 
 
• **"Cannibal"** refers to a human or an animal that eats the flesh of its own species. (आदमखोर)
 
 
• **Example:** Some tribes in history were known to be cannibals.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Cannib
